thread.title: Baylor baseball scores five in ninth to defeat Cincinnati 8-3
thread.title_full: Baylor baseball scores five in ninth to defeat Cincinnati 8-3

author: h. k. mckee
title: Baylor baseball scores five in ninth to defeat Cincinnati 8-3
text:
Baylor baseball won an 8-3 game against Cincinnati on April 12, scoring five runs in the top of the ninth inning at UC Baseball Stadium to secure a victory and avoid a series sweep.
The win is significant for Baylor as it marks their first road win over Cincinnati in program history and keeps their streak alive of not being swept in their last 16 Big 12 series. The Bears improved their record to 20-15 overall and 8-7 in Big 12 play, while Cincinnati fell to 24-14 and 6-9 in conference games.
Freshman outfielder Brady Janusek contributed three hits, including a two-run double during the decisive ninth inning. Baylor had six players with multiple hits, totaling fifteen for the game. Fifth-year senior right-hander Caleb Bunch earned his fourth win after pitching three scoreless innings following starter Ethan Calder’s performance. Calder allowed three runs over five and two-thirds innings with six strikeouts.
The Bears took an early lead but trailed twice before tying the game at three runs each heading into the final frame. In the top of the ninth, Baylor’s offense came alive: Bo Caraway started with a triple, Travis Sanders drove him home, Pearson Riebock doubled again, and Janusek delivered another key hit as part of a rally that saw all five batters reach safely before an out was recorded.
Several individual milestones were achieved during this contest. According to team statistics from this season, Baylor now has sixty-three stolen bases through thirty-five games—their highest total since at least 2003—and have had thirteen games with double-digit hits. This is also the first season since 2013 that three or more Bears have reached double figures in stolen bases: Janusek (13), Sanders (10), and Riebock (10).
Looking ahead, Baylor will host UTSA on Tuesday evening at Magnolia Field at Baylor Ballpark as they begin a week featuring several home games against Texas rivals.
